% A document written for pdflatex that reads the name of a form with
% \pdfxformname after \pdfxform, and the bounding box of an image with
% \pdfximagebbox after \pdfximage. Both are expandable, so they are read
% in an \xdef or an \edef, typeset in the text, in italic, sans-serif, and
% typewriter text, a footnote, a theorem, and a heading written to the
% table of contents, given \pdflastxform, a count register, an explicit
% number, or a macro, followed by a digit or \relax, and in the text of a
% \special, which is expanded when the page is shipped out. In the PDF the
% name is the form's number and the bounding box the image's. On the page
% the name is empty, as the form is not drawn, the bounding box is zero,
% and the text around each stays.
\pdfoutput=1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newcount\formno
\newcount\imgno
\def\formone{1}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents

\setbox2\hbox{x}\pdfxform2 \xdef\formname{\pdfxformname\pdflastxform}

\section{Form name [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end}

Details: [\formname] end.

\edef\formedef{\pdfxformname\pdflastxform}%
Edef: [\formedef] end.

Text: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end.

Italic: \emph{a[\pdfxformname\pdflastxform]b end}.

Sans: \textsf{c[\pdfxformname\pdflastxform]d end}.

Typewriter: \texttt{e[\pdfxformname\pdflastxform]f end}.

Footnote: before\footnote{Note [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end.} after.

\begin{theorem}
Theorem [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end.
\end{theorem}

\setbox2\hbox{y}\pdfxform attr{/Foo 1} resources{/Bar 2} 2
\formno=\pdflastxform
Count: [\pdfxformname\formno] end.

Explicit: [\pdfxformname 1 ] end.

Macro: [\pdfxformname\formone] end.

Digit: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform 5] end.

Space digit: [\pdfxformname 1 5] end.

Relax: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\relax] end.

Special: before\special{pdf: q /Fm\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\space Do Q} after.

\immediate\pdfximage{test-picture.png}\imgno=\pdflastximage
\xdef\bbox{\pdfximagebbox\pdflastximage 3}%
Bbox: [\bbox] end.

\dimen0=\pdfximagebbox\pdflastximage 3\relax
Bbox dimen: [\the\dimen0] end.

Bbox count: [\pdfximagebbox\imgno 1] end.
\end{document}
